title: Analysts’ Connections and M&A Outcomes
eligible_reason: Deal-level cross-sectional regressions of M&A outcomes (CARs, synergies, completion) on shared analyst coverage (inter, dummy) with acquirer-industry, target-industry and year FE and many deal and firm controls (Tables 5, 8). Table 6 uses a matched sample around reductions in shared coverage with the matching variables as controls. Reg FD splits use a single 2000 date (post_fd). No unit panel with staggered adoption; no data shipped.
design_notes: Data for replication/Master_Final_MS.do lines 170-237 (Tables 5-6) and 1308-1344 (Reg FD interactions).
data_files_note: Only do files and a log; the .dta inputs listed in the README are not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
